blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — For a month, paranormal investigator Bernie Bernardo and his fiancée stayed on the second floor of a three-storey home. Their stay was temporary since their old home was undergoing renovations. A window offered a view of the balcony connected to the other floors. One afternoon, while moving things into their new house, Bernie saw a child laughing near the balcony. Thinking it was either one of the children living on the upper floors or a visiting child from the neighborhood, he called out: “Oy, ngano niduol ka diha?
